programme.desc: Blue and Steve are playing song games and it's Blue's turn to choose a song. We play Blue's Clues to figure out which song game she wants to play.
programme.sub-title: Blue Wants To Play a Song Game!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue and Steve have just finished making newspaper hats and Blue wants to make something else. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to make.
programme.sub-title: What Does Blue Want To Make?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue and Steve just finished putting on a play and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what other story Blue wants to play.
programme.sub-title: What Story Does Blue Want To Play?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue, Steve, and Tickety are going to read Tickety Tock's favorite nursery rhyme, but which one is it? We play Blue's Clues to figure it out.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue is scared and we play Blue's Clues to determine what is frightening her.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue has a playdate with her best friend Magenta. We play Blue's Clues to determine what Blue wants to do when Magenta comes over.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue has big news and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it is.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Steve has the sniffles. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue thinks Steve needs to feel better.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to build.
programme.sub-title: What Does Blue Want To Build?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue leaves tactile, visual, and audio clues for us and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to play next.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue and Steve are experimenting by playing sink and float, but Blue wants to try another experiment. We play Blue's Clues to figure out which experiment Blue wants to try next.
programme.sub-title: What Experiment Does Blue Want To Try?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue and Steve are busy cleaning. Steve throws things away but Blue wants to use old things to make something new. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to make.
programme.sub-title: What Does Blue Want To Make Out of Recycled Things?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue had a dream and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue's dream was about.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We play Blue's Clues to figure out what book Blue wants to read.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to buy. Along the way we help Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper figure out who has more apples, how to make them equal, and the total number they have all together.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Everyone's invited to Blue's big event! We play Blue's Clues to figure out what present Blue wants for her birthday.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue drew a picture and we play Blue's Clues to figure what Blue wants to do with it.
programme.sub-title: What Does Blue Want To Do With Her Picture?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: As it starts to rain, Steve and Blue discover that the raindrops sound like music. Blue decides she would like to do something musical, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do on this rainy day.
programme.sub-title: What Does Blue Wanna Do on a Rainy Day?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue has a surprise for us, but it won't be ready until 2 o'clock. Using our watch, we time activities and discover the difference between seconds and minutes while we wait for our surprise.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue was when she lost her backpack. Guided by a hand saying -- Go back, go back, go back to where you were!

programme.title: South Park: Oussama Ben Laden pue du cul
programme.desc: Kenny, Cartman, Stan et Kyle sont envoyés par erreur en Afghanistan. Sur place et contre toute attente, ils vont s'apercevoir qu'ils ont beaucoup de points communs avec les enfants Afghans.
programme.sub-title: Oussama Ben Laden pue du cul

programme.title: South Park: Comment manger avec son cul
programme.desc: Cartman placarde la photo de Kenny associée à la mention 'Enfant disparu' sur tous les packs de lait du pays.

programme.title: South Park: L'Engin
programme.desc: Mr Garrison, ne supportant plus que ses vols d'avions soient annulés ou retardés, décide d'inventer un nouveau moyen de transport.Kyle est très embarrassé quand il reçoit la visite de son cousin de New-York, également prénommé Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Les riches debarquent
programme.desc: Se sentant rejeté, Token décide d'appeler d'autres riches. Mais les hommes de la ville ne supportent pas l'arrivée de ces riches.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny Se Meurt
programme.desc: Cartman tente de sauver la vie de Kenny en suppliant le Congrès de faire reprendre la recherche sur les cellules souches.

programme.title: South Park: L'Episode de Butters
programme.desc: Butters fait quelques découvertes qui vont changer le cours de son existence. Son père est bisexuel et sa mère tente de le tuer. Heureusement tout s'arrange à la fin.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Maury Povich Show reçoit des personnes difformes et leur offre des cadeaux. Les gamins décident d'envoyer Butters au show avec des testicules en latex attachées au menton.

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Vacances à Aspen. Les gamins ont des ennuis avec des ados fous de ski et les parents vont vivre l'enfer de l'arnaque.

programme.title: South Park: La bande-annonce du nouveau Terrance et Phillip
programme.desc: Le visionnage d'une bande annonce se transforme en course contre la montre pour trouver une télé valable.
programme.sub-title: La bande-annonce du nouveau Terrance et Phillip

programme.title: South Park: Le veau, c'est rigolo
programme.desc: Les enfants se soucient du sort des veaux qui sont en réalité des bébé vaches torturés.

programme.title: South Park: Professeur Chaos
programme.desc: Butters est exclu du groupe des gamins. Excedé, il s'invente un alter-égo maléfique, le Professeur Chaos. Pendant ce temps, Stan, Cartman et Kyle mettent en place une sélection pour trouver un remplaçant à Kenny.

programme.title: South Park: Les cathos, c'est chaud
programme.desc: Le père Maxi propose aux enfants de partir pour une croisière en compagnie de prêtres et d'évêques venus de tous les pays. Mais Randy raconte qu'il a entendu aux informations que les prêtres faisaient subir des mauvais traitements aux enfants.

programme.title: South Park: Bérets Gratos
programme.desc: Les gamins en ont marre que les scénaristes retouchent leurs films avec des images de synthèse ou en éditant les images ou les mots choquants.

programme.title: South Park: Les seins de Bebe mettent en danger la société
programme.desc: La puberté fait irruption à South Park: Barbara a des seins qui poussent et les garçons ont un comportement des plus bizarres.
programme.sub-title: Les seins de Bebe mettent en danger la société

programme.title: South Park: Les enlèvements d'enfants, c'est pas marrant
programme.desc: Les parents sont victimes de la psychose de l'enlèvement. Au fil des infos, ils apprennent que leurs enfants peuvent être enlevés par eux-mêmes.
programme.sub-title: Les enlèvements d'enfants, c'est pas marrant

programme.title: South Park: Une échelle pour aller au ciel
programme.desc: Pour profiter d'une razzia de bonbons, les gamins sont contraints de retrouver Kenny au ciel pour récuperer un ticket de la plus haute importance.
programme.sub-title: Une échelle pour aller au ciel

programme.title: South Park: Le retour de la communauté de l'anneau des deux tours
programme.desc: Une nuit de folie, où les gamins passionnés par Le Seigneur des anneaux vont entretenir un quiproquo terrible à propos d'un film pornographique substitué à une copie du Seigneur.
programme.sub-title: Le retour de la communauté de l'anneau des deux tours

programme.title: South Park: Le camp de la mort de tolérance
programme.desc: Les parents veulent sauver leurs enfants de la spirale de l'intolérance. En même temps Mr Garrison en fait peut-être trop. Et une pauvre gerbille vit un road movie passionnant dans les entrailles de Mr Esclave.
programme.sub-title: Le camp de la mort de tolérance

programme.title: South Park: Le Plus Gros Connard de l'Univers
programme.desc: Chef et Mme Cartman décident de purger Eric de l'âme de Kenny. Pendant ce temps Stan tente de prouver que John Edward est un imposteur. Les voies de la solution s'avèreront d'ordre stellaire.
programme.sub-title: Le Plus Gros Connard de l'Univers

programme.title: South Park: Mon Futur Moi et Moi
programme.desc: Un homme se présentant comme le Stan Marsh du futur arrive à South Park. Le Stan du passé est littéralement effaré de voir qu'il tombera dans une telle déchéance.

programme.title: South Park: La Chute du traîneau rouge
programme.desc: Cartman est très tendu. Il a commis trop de mauvaises actions pour espérer avoir des cadeaux à ce Noël. Il tente alors de se racheter en convaincant le Père Noël d'apporter Noël en Irak.

programme.title: South Park: I'm a Little Bit Country
programme.desc: La sonde anale de Cartman est réactivée. Les garçons se retrouvent dans l'espace et ils ont une mission très, très importante: Sauver la terre!

programme.title: South Park: Les gangs de Denver
programme.desc: Timmy aide Jimmy à former un club composé d'autres enfants handicapés de naissance. Ils sont heureux de découvrir qu'un groupe de ce genre existe déjà.

programme.title: South Park: Papier toilette
programme.desc: Cartman veut faire une crasse à son prof, qui vient de le punir. Pour se venger, il demande aux garçons de se joindre à lui pour remplir la maison du prof de papier toilette.

programme.title: South Park: Gros Cul et Tête de Nœud
programme.desc: Kyle vient de réaliser un brillant exposé sur la culture hispano-américaine. C'est désormais au tour de Cartman de se lancer dans un discours sur les artistes hispano-américains.
programme.sub-title: Gros Cul et Tête de Nœud

programme.title: South Park: Les petits policiers
programme.desc: Les enfants décident de jouer les détectives privés. Leur première affaire consiste à retrouver une tarte à la cerise.

programme.title: South Park: La Cupidité de L'Homme Rouge
programme.desc: Monsieur Broslofsky perd tout son argent dans un casino indien. Les indiens rachètent South Park pour construire une autoroute géante.

programme.title: South Park: est Gay!
programme.desc: La nouvelle folie 'métrosexuelle' (un show télévisé) envahit la ville de South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Rock chrétien
programme.desc: Suite à un pari avec Kyle, Cartman décide de monter un groupe de rock chrétien avec Token et Butters, dans le but d'obtenir un disque de platine.

programme.title: South Park: Rencontre du troisième âge
programme.desc: À South Park, comme dans tout le pays, les vieux au volant sont considérés comme un fléau. Une loi est votée pour leur confisquer leur permis de conduire. Mais le troisième âge contre-attaque.

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: La mère de Kyle doit emmener ce dernier et ses amis à Casa Bonita, une version mexicaine de Disneyland au Colorado. Au lieu d'inviter Cartman, Kyle lui préfère Butters.

programme.title: South Park: Tout sur les Mormons
programme.desc: Un enfant mormon arrive dans la classe des garçons. Stan est supposé lui casser la figure, mais son père et lui sont soudain fascinés par la religion des nouveaux venus, et leur extrême gentillesse. Stan ne tardera pas à revenir sur son avis.

programme.title: South Park: Stop clopes
programme.desc: Les garçons sont surpris en train de fumer après avoir vu un spectacle ringard contre la cigarette. Rob Reiner, militant extrémiste anti-tabac, décide de piéger les fabricants de cigarettes avec l'aide des garçons.

programme.title: South Park: Raisins
programme.desc: Stan déprime quand Wendy le plaque. Ses amis l'emmènent alors au 'Raisins', réputé pour ses hôtesses de bar sexy. Butters tombe amoureux de l'une d'entre elles, et Stan décide de devenir gothique.

programme.title: South Park: Noël au Canada
programme.desc: Les parents biologiques d'Ike reviennent le chercher chez les parents de Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Les armes, c'est rigolo
programme.desc: Grâce à un stratagème surfait, les garçons obtiennent des armes ninja. Alors qu'ils jouent, ils blessent leur camarade Butters. Pris dans un dilemme draconien, les garçons décident de le déguiser en chien pour l'emmener chez le véterinaire.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Corazon's double-dealing with the Navy raises suspicions both with Doflamingo and Law. But all that is secondary as Corazon finally has a chance to grab the Op-Op Fruit during a staged handoff arranged by the Government.
programme.sub-title: The Time is Ticking Down! Seize the Op-Op Fruit!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Op-Op Fruit is in Corazon's hands! But the price he paid to get it might be too high... When Law goes for help, unfortunate coincidences intervene and leave the two vulnerable! Meanwhile, Doflamingo and his clan finally land at Minion Island.
programme.sub-title: The Moment of Resolution! Corazon's Farewell Smile!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Doflamingo & his Family begin to zero in on Corazon and Law's whereabouts, but Corazon has a plan to hide Law long enough to let him escape, even if that means sacrificing his own life. A chain of lucky coincidences allows the plan to be set into motion.
programme.sub-title: Advance, Law! The Kindhearted Man's Final Fight!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Violet runs down the status of the open battles raging in Dressrosa - the Straw Hats, the Tontattas, the executives of the Doflamingo Family - all of them clash around the island, but it's Law's revelation to Doflamingo that moves the action forward!
programme.sub-title: To Be Free! Law's Injection Shot Blasts!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy continues to battle Fake-mingo, but keeps accidentally battling Bellamy instead. Meanwhile the tide of battle turns against Law as painful scars from the past resurface. And Zoro gets unexpected help in his battle with Pica.
programme.sub-title: An Intense Battle! Law vs. Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bellamy escapes Doflamingo's control, but it might be too late. His long history with Doflamingo unfolds and leads to an inglorious end. Meanwhile, Hajrudin has been beaten down, but a fire still burns in him to pay back the favor he owes!
programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle Against the Executives! Proud Hajrudin!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Lao G and Don Chinjao duke it out as each brings their most devastating attacks to the battle. But a misunderstanding caused by Baby 5 has Sai and Don Chinjao distracted - are they distracted enough for Lao G to gain the upper hand?
programme.sub-title: The Battle of Love! The New Leader Sai vs. Baby 5!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law is at the whim of Doflamingo and Trebol, while Luffy still has to deal with Bellamy, who fights to keep his honor even after being released by Doflamingo! Meanwhile, Gladius is about to detonate the ground around Cavendish and Bartolomeo!
programme.sub-title: The Man's Pride! Bellamy's Last Charge!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A mysterious force that resembles Cavendish menaces the battlefield - but while it appears to help Bartolomeo and the others at first, it sets its sights on Robin! Meanwhile, the deeply-wounded Ideo sees Dellinger's horrible true nature!
programme.sub-title: A Strong Wind and a Surge! Hakuba vs. Dellinger!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bartolomeo is in a neck-and-neck battle against Gladius to save Robin, and is faced with an impossible dilemma. With all his options leading to their defeat, can his cunning ploy save the day? Meanwhile, Robin is face to face with Cavendish.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Princess Mansherry's amazing power - to heal living beings completely - is in the hands of the Donquixote executive. If she is able to heal all the executives who've gone down in battle - the Straw Hats and their allies stand no chance!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Señor Pink and Franky continue their knock-down, drag-out, manly fight. As both of them are pushed to their limits, we learn Señor's tragic past! Meanwhile, Princess Mansherry's rescue hits a snag as she stubbornly refuses to leave!
programme.sub-title: The Manly Duel! Señor's Elegy of Love!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Franky and Señor Pink end their harrowing duel in a manly way - but victory knocks the wind out of even the winner's sails! Meanwhile, Diamante and Kyros struggle desperately on the Sunflower Field, each demonstrating their extreme prowess.
programme.sub-title: Stardust of Death! Diamante's Storm of Vicious Attacks!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kyros, unbowed by Diamante's vicious attacks, fights back with the anger and retribution of all of Dressrosa in order to fulfill his promise to protect Rebecca. If he is successful, only a few executives will remain.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Pica loses his temper and turns his full wrath against King Riku, whom he hopes to destroy, ending the revolution against Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Zoro, who has been distracted by Pica and drawn far from the battle, has to hatch a plan to save the king!
programme.sub-title: Moving Across the Ground! The Giant Statue Pica's Surprise Maneuver!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With the lives of King Riku, Usopp, and the others on the old King's Plateau in the balance, Zoro must dig deep and discover a powerful technique to counter Pica's near-unstoppable onslaught. Meanwhile, King Riku ponders what it means to be a good king.
programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle in Midair! Zoro's New Special Secret Technique Blasts!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro finishes off Pica, and those below his crumbling body rush to find shelter. Meanwhile, the Tontattas finish up demolishing the SMILE Factory, and Luffy's hand is forced in his duel with Bellamy!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Taking down Bellamy only enrages Luffy in his fight against Doflamingo, his anger multiplying when he finds Law's lifeless body! Meanwhile, Doflamingo takes the next step to end the game he started, which will endanger everybody in Dressrosa!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Birdcage draws tighter and tighter around Dressrosa, threatening to destroy all life on the island kingdom! Meanwhile, Doflamingo stands down Luffy for a final confrontation, but a surprising twist shocks everyone on the top of the Royal Palace!
programme.sub-title: A Blade of Tenacity! The Gamma Knife Counterattack!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law's attack proves powerful - but Doflamingo's power has depths which he and Luffy haven't bargained for. When Doflamingo makes his counterattack, Luffy stares him down with an amazing power.
programme.sub-title: A Collision of Haki! Luffy vs. Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Trebol's wrath is fully inflamed as Law summons enough energy to speak, denouncing the Doflamingo Family executives as pawns in Doflamingo's game. But Law gathers enough energy to do more than just speak out.
programme.sub-title: Unassailable! The Stunning Secret of Trebol!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Cavendish has to make a difficult decision when the severely wounded Law begs him to be left behind. Meanwhile, seeing even his Second Gear or Third Gear attacks aren't working against Doflamingo, Luffy decides to use his ultimate technique!
programme.sub-title: Anger Erupts! I Will Take Everything upon Myself!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Doflamingo duke it out while the Birdcage tightens its grip on Dressrosa! Zoro sets off with a plan to stop it from slicing apart the country, while Luffy's Fourth Gear proves quite potent against Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.desc: Poor Sue Ellen has lost the one thing she's never without--her diary. Then, Arthur's hurt his knee but won't tell Mom--because then she'd know he'd been playing down at the dump , where he was NOT allowed to go.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and D.W. are planning a surprise party for Grandma Thora. But amidst the party-planning mayhem, they forget about the guest of honor! Then, shy Fern hosts a slumber party at her mother's urging.
programme.sub-title: Grandma Thora Appreciation Day/Fern's Slumber Party

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Muffy tries to bribe the judges at the school science fair, Francine and The Brain plot revenge. And D.W., a newly-deputized Junior Safety Officer, has a reputation for being a strict enforcer of the rules--well, OK, a tattle-tale.
programme.sub-title: Love Notes For Muffy/D.W. Blows The Whistle

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Francine and Catherine are very different, but it’s no fun if you're two sisters sharing the same room. Then, there's only one thing in life Arthur really wants—to win! But he just can't stop losing. Is it really so wrong to cheat a little?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and The Brain encounter a new crossing guard on the way home from school. This guard isn't just mean, he's nuts! And, D.W. is making Arthur's life miserable! Francine decides she'd fix D.W.'s behavior before Arthur loses his mind.
programme.sub-title: Arthur vs. The Very Mean Crossing Guard/D.W.'s Very Bad Mood

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. and Arthur get their feelings hurt when their efforts to insult each other get out of control. Next, Arthur, Brain, and Binky find a key--but to what? And which of them will get to keep whatever fabulous thing they find with it?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What's a budding entrepreneur to do when her homemade cookies hit the big time? Especially when the recipe isn't really hers? Then, Arthur and Francine would love to lend their sisters to Sue Ellen, who's sick of being an only child.
programme.sub-title: How The Cookie Crumbles/Sue Ellen's Littler Sister

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster's coming home! The word spreads fast, but so does the fear that Buster will be different. Then, it seems to Buster, not only have his friends changed while he was gone, but they've forgotten all about him! Will he ever fit in again?
programme.sub-title: Buster's Back/The Ballad Of Buster Baxter

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Ms. Morgan announces they'll be having a fire drill during preschool, D.W. wants no part of it--it sounds way too scary. Then, the Tibble Twins are better than D.W. at just about everything.
programme.sub-title: D.W., All Fired Up/I'd Rather Read It Myself

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Since they rescued Wilbur Rabbit, Arthur and Muffy have been inseparable. But the rest of their friends are growing tired of the new Arthur. And, Brain's a great partner for a school assignment--unless you wanted to work on it, too!
programme.sub-title: Arthur Goes Crosswire/Sue Ellen And The Brainasaurous

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Wouldn't it be cool to find out that your ancestors were famous frontier explorers? But what if they were just...plain folks? The Magic Toolbox show is coming to Ratburn's class to put the kids on TV!
programme.sub-title: Background Blues/And Now Let's Talk To Some Kids

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What a mysterious, beautiful thing a green potato chip is--and D.W. just ate a gigantic one! But then she hears a rumor that they're poisonous...Sure, kids do some pretty embarrassing things, but do Moms have to tell everyone?
programme.sub-title: The Chips Are Down/Revenge Of The Chip

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Writing your own name in graffiti all over the school wouldn't be very smart, right? Binky says he didn't do it, so detectives Fern and Buster are on the case. Then, Binky is the newest, hottest, hippest pop music craze in Elwood City.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Woogles have their own names and personalities and they're so darned cute! And Arthur's gotta have one, especially now that everyone is collecting them. Arthur wouldn't mind if Dad's infamous dessert "experiments" remained a family secret.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Rides The Bandwagon/Dad's Dessert Dilemma

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen and Fern take a popularity quiz in a magazine and change their personalities to become more likable, but it backfires. And Buster's convinced that his great joke will be the difference between a successful oral report and failure.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Buster digs up an ancient arrowhead, everyone else wants to hunt for buried treasures, too. And a field trip to the Medieval Fair pits Arthur's class against another led by Ratburn's super-tough mentor, Mr. Pryce-Jones.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Treasure Hunt/The Return Of The King

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: If you think the Tibbles are bad now, imagine what they'd be like if they had super powers! Then, D.W. needs money, quick. When she tries to pull a fast one on the Tooth Fairy, will Arthur have to pay?
programme.sub-title: Attack Of The Turbo Tibbles/D.W. Tricks The Tooth Fairy

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Playing with the Tibble twins requires preparation, endurance and earplugs. But when one gets sick, playing with the other should be a lot easier, right? Arthur and the gang create their own music videos.
programme.sub-title: Double Tibble Trouble/Arthur's Almost Live Not Real Music Festival

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen's not afraid of much, but when she encounters a really creepy howling noise in the woods, she's scared for real. Then, Grandma Thora has a lot of fun stuff, especially her porcelain doll, Clarissa.
programme.sub-title: What Scared Sue Ellen?/Clarissa Is Cracked

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When painfully shy George brings a ventriloquist dummy to school, a popular kid is born! Then, Arthur thinks the best pet to have is a dog, and Francine probably would have agreed--that is, until little Nemo, a cute kitten, came along.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Dummy Disaster/Francine and The Feline

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Mom and Dad fight over spilled milk, Arthur and D.W. fear the worst. Is it Arthur's fault or D.W.'s? Then, turning five is a major, big deal event! But D.W. worries that she fribbled away her preschool years on meaningless pursuits.
programme.sub-title: Mom and Dad Have A Great Big Fight/D.W.'s Perfect Wish

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur just might make it to Happy Crazy Wow Day at the park--if he and D.W. can work together to clean their rooms! Then, Arthur and the gang realize they are suffering from the January doldrums brought on by an acute lack of holidays.
programme.sub-title: Arthur and D.W. Clean Up/The Long, Dull Winter

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When D.W. discovers that she can get her own library card, she rejoices at the world of books waiting for her. And, is it ever okay to hit someone? Sometimes you just get so mad, you wanna....pow! Right??

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The kids capture a snake and learn that it's possibly poisonous--after it gets lost in Arthur's house! Why is Muffy interviewing for a new best friend? She and Francine are usually inseparable, but lately it seems they have less in common.
programme.sub-title: Hide And Snake/Muffy's New Best Friend

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Will Buster's friends treat him the same after they learn he has asthma? Prankster have arrived in Elwood City--just in time for the "Scare Your Pants Off" costume party! It's boys vs. girls in what becomes a great big battle of the pranks.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What would happen if Arthur and his friends entered a contest to write stories for their favorite TV show? Then, look out world, D.W. has discovered science! But D.W.'s new-found passion proves that a little knowledge is a dangerous thing.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A blizzard comes to town, taking out the electricity and sending residents scrambling for supplies. Can neighbors find ways to help each other survive through the storm? Then, the unthinkable is happening...Arthur's teacher is moving in!
programme.sub-title: The Blizzard/The Rat Who Came To Dinner

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What happens when you combine Greek Mythology with D.W.'s imagination? Then, getting two Polly Locket dolls almost ruins Prunella's birthday party. That, and Francine's bad mood--why, she wouldn't even sing the Happy Birthday song!
programme.sub-title: D.W. Tale Spins/Prunella Gets It Twice

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Does Binky have a favorite pastime? Not until citywide Bug Week, when suddenly all he can think about is butterflies. Then, there's a horrible racket in Elwood City, and it's Francine practicing her singing and drumming for the Talent Show!
programme.sub-title: Binky Barnes, Wingman/To Beat Or Not To Beat

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Buster insists that he will miss the Father's Day picnic because he has other plans, Arthur is convinced that he's really sad and embarrassed about his parents’ divorce. And Prunella predicts a gift of flashpants, the hot new fashion.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and friends are all faced with seemingly impossible tasks, from fixing a model biplane to babysitting D.W. And, Buster knows he's fun, but he's beginning to feel like he's not particularly good at anything.
programme.sub-title: What Is That Thing?/Buster's Best Behavior

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's the duel of the century as cellist Yo-Yo Ma faces jazz saxophonist Joshua Redman in the toughest gig of their careers at the Elwood City Library! Then, will Arthur be exposed as a baby show lover?
programme.sub-title: My Music Rules/That's A Baby Show!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Alex Trebek lends his voice as gameshow host Alex Lebek in this episode which poses the age-old riddle--is winning really everything? What if your friends dared you to skip homework--and then double dared you to skip school?
programme.sub-title: Arthur And The Big Riddle/Double Dare

programme.desc: Through rain, snow, heat, or gloom of night, we expect postmen to deliver the mail; the U.S. Post Office handles over 603-million pieces of mail daily; yet it represents only 43% of the world's total mail volume.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Freight trains transport 1.8 billion tons annually as America's economic lifeblood, carrying crops, electronics, cars, chemicals, and coal; explore Union Pacific's Bailey yard, the world's greatest freight system, from mining tramway origins.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: In less than a century, the world went from dirt tracks to highways, from propeller planes to space travel, from sailboats to supertankers; in the process, a glut of traffic was created on roadways, railways, airways, and seaways.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: It's the place where one man's trash is truly another man's treasure; enter the mysterious world of the junkyard, where many pieces actually do add up to a whole; uncover how junkyard operators create order out of seemingly random piles of junk.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The Massachusetts Central Artery/Tunnel Project, a.k.a. The Big Dig, is an impressive municipal construction project in U.S.; its objective to replace Boston's decaying highway infrastructure with 160 new highway miles.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Giant robots work factory floors and outer space; floating fortresses house 6,000 military personnel with length matching Empire State Building's height; diesel engines produce 108,000 horsepower in audacious engineering feats worldwide.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: A study of the discoveries, inventions and technological advances that have helped us understand and predict weather; from observations made by early humans, to Doppler radar and satellite imaging, we'll see how man has tried to harness weather.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The ability to transmit sound in stereo transformed the music of life into a rich symphony of sound; for over 100 years, enthusiasts and scientists have worked to create the ideal listening experience; we examine this multi-billion dollar business.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Americans insert more than 3.5 million coins into vending machines every 15 minutes; how vending machines work; visiting a factory that produces high-tech vending machines; giant gumball machine.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Adam Richman gets to see how Wise produces over 50 million bags of sweet and salty snacks per month; how Jack Link's is changing the jerky game.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Around the world, people consume billions of gallons of milk every day; a cow-milking parlor; pasteurization; a three-story milk evaporator; milking a yak; the world's largest butter churn; yogurt.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Termites, mosquitos, rats, mice, ants and cockroaches have spread damage, disease and death for millions of years.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.desc: Big machines span NASA's world's biggest wind tunnel and flight simulator, Joy Mining's Continuous Miner underground machine, London Eye's 443-foot observation wheel, IMAX's largest film technology, and Claas Cougar world's biggest lawnmower.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Odd Squad/For Emergencies Only: Timmy wishes he had a talking car. Cosmo and Wanda are so busy with Poof they’re neglecting Timmy.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Cheese and Crockers/Land Before Timmy: Timmy wishes up a machine that allows him to merge with other items to become half-Timmy/half-whatever. Timmy’s tired of technology taking over and ruining his life so he wishes for a simpler world.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Merry Wishmas!: When Timmy doesn’t get what he wants for Christmas he simply wishes for it. But his friends can’t do the same, so Timmy wishes every kid could get a magical coupon that would allow them to wish for the one thing they didn't get.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: King Chang/The End of the Universe-ity: Shya! Mark Chang is called back to Yugopotamia to become king while his father, under attack from a mystery assailant, flees for his life. Dark Laser’s back and tries to make Timmy his apprentice!
programme.sub-title: King Chang/The End of the Universe-ity

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Sooper Poof: Poof is trying to get the hang of shape shifting – unfortunately he takes after Cosmo! Timmy’s been running Cosmo and Wanda ragged so Jorgen takes him to "Wishing Well."

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Wishy Washy/Poof's Play Date: Dad entrusts Timmy with washing and preserving his classic Stryker Z sports car! Wanda worries that Poof doesn’t have interaction with other fairy babies, so Timmy turns the adult fairies into babies, so Poof can play with.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Vicky Gets Fired/CHINdred Spirits: Vicky is determined to get a job after Timmy's parents fire her. Timmy wishes up a girlfriend for Crimson Chin and soon the Chin dating a woman named Golden Locks…except now the comic is both boring and romantic.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: 9 Lives/Dread 'n' Breakfast: When Catman tells Timmy that he’s used up 8 of his 9 cat lives saving Dimmsdale from crime, Timmy helps Catman find a "safer" job where he can still help people. Mom turns the house into a bed and breakfast!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Birthday bashed/Momnipresent: Timmy is excited for his birthday until he realizes that one year older means one year closer to losing his fairies. He spends the entire day trying to thwart all party plans, leading his Mom and Dad to think he's gone crazy!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Timmy goes on an adventure to search for his fairies and a magical wand that will defeat the Darkness.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Timmy goes on an adventure to search for his fairies and a magical wand that will defeat the Darkness.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Timmy learns he merely slowed down The Darkness and now he must seek a second wand to defeat this evil force. Timmy is forced to make amends with his enemies in order to fight for mankind.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Confident and secure, Timmy feels great having won the battle against The Darkness. His world is quickly turned upside down as he learns that he didn’t win, but is now living inside The Darkness!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Anti-Poof: For every fairy, there’s an anti-fairy – thus anti-Poof is born – FOOP! It’s up to Poof to stop this anti-fairy from destroying Fairy World and his loved ones.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Add-A-Dad/Squirrely Puffs: Dad is too busy to spend quality time with Timmy, so he wishes up "a-lot-a-dads" to hang out with. It's a race between the Squirrely Scouts and the Cream Puffs to the top of Mount Doom!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Mice-Capades/Formula For Disaster: Poof has been watching too much of a classic, yet violent "cat & mouse" cartoon. He innocently turns Timmy and Vicky into "Cheesy and Sleazy" and all mayhem breaks loose.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Bad Heir Day/Freaks and Greeks: Crocker wants an heir to his supposed "fortune and fame." Poof coincidentally ends up in his care and Crocker is set for life.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Fly Boy/Temporary Fairy: Everybody in Dimmsdale is watching the latest horror film, "Fly Boy." But Timmy isn't allowed to, so when he wishes to become a "fly on the wall".

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Crocker Shocker/Super Zero: Crocker is hypnotized into no longer believing in fairies and becomes normal again. Unfortunately, Fairy World can no longer feed off his spastic energy, and all their magic shuts down.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Dadbracadbra/Timmy Turnip: With a little help from Timmy, Dad’s magic tricks really work. Convinced that Timmy’s dad is a fairy, Crocker is out to prove it and uncover his secret on national television.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: One Man Banned/Frenemy Mine: After Timmy’s rejected from the school band, he wishes everyone would love his music./Timmy saves Vicky from a horrible accident and suddenly she is stricken by his generosity.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Chicken Poofs/Stupid Cupid: Poof gets the "Chicken Poofs" and turns everyone into actual chickens! Timmy steals Cupid's arrows in an attempt to make Trixie fall in love with him and go to the school "Romance Dance."

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Double Oh Schnozmo/Planet Poof: Cosmo’s brother, the top secret spy, pays a visit. But when Schnozmo’s revealed to be nothing but a con man, Wanda demands that Schnozmo participate in a real spy adventure in order to spare Cosmo’s feelings.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: It's "Bring Your Kid to Work Day," and Dad takes Timmy to his office. When Timmy accidentally eats Poof (who is hiding as a marshmallow in Timmy's cereal) Timmy becomes magically talented at soccer.
programme.sub-title: The Boss of Me/He Poofs, He Scores!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Play Date... of Doom/Teacher's Pet: Foop is back! He’s escaped from prison and convinced Cosmo and Wanda he’s ready for a playdate with Poof. But he’s really there to try and destroy his arch enemy again, and it’s up to Timmy and Poof to thwart his plan.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: When Timmy gripes that being Mom is easier than being a kid, Wanda takes the bait and switches their brains. Now Mom is Timmy, and Timmy is Mom!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: When Mom and Dad mistake Cosmo for a ghost and restart their failed ghost-hunting business, Timmy wishes that the fairies would pretend to haunt Dimmsdale.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: After failing miserably on a game show for 6th graders, Dad admits he dropped out of school in the 5th grade. The next thing Timmy knows, Dad’s in his class!
programme.sub-title: Old Man and the C-/Balance of Flour

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Food Fight/Please Don't Feed the Turners: Tired of Mom’s terrible dinners, Timmy wishes Mom were the best chef in the world.
programme.sub-title: Food Fight/Please Don't Feed the Turners

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Timmy borrows Mark Chang’s Fake-i-fier in order to attend Trixie’s costume party. Unfortunately, he knows nothing about Yugopotamian technology and soon the device is causing Timmy to turn into all sorts of crazy creatures.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: An exhausted Timmy makes a wish for complete darkness so he can get some sleep. But he doesn’t count on Cosmo and Wanda turning into Scary Fairies in the dark.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Dad decides to convert the Turner home into a farm. Unfortunately, it takes Cosmo and Wanda’s magic to give Dad a green thumb, and when they’re swept away by a tornado, it’s up to Timmy to save the farm...and his fairies!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Dad changes Timmy’s room into a surveillance center to prove that his kindly neighbor, Dinkleberg, is truly evil. Being the best neighbor ever, Dinkleberg pretends to be evil just to make Dad feel better.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Poof and Foop compete to win the affections of Goldie Goldenglow, a magical new girl at Spellementary School (who’s shaped like a triangle) while participating in the Spellementary School play, "Mr. Cookie’s Happy Day."

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The artists create single-needle tattoos for inmates in their first Flash Challenge, and canvases seek cover-ups in the elimination challenge.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The artists team up to create customized grills for lowrider cars, canvases sit for gory tattoos, and NFL star Chris Johnson joins the panel as a guest judge.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The artists test their texture skills in a sexy Flash Challenge, a difficult canvas leads to a second elimination, and tattoo veteran Tony Hundahl joins as a guest judge.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The artists must assemble their own tattoo machines before tattooing bar codes onto their canvases, and tattoo machine innovator Seth Ciferri joins as a guest judge.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The artists tackle tattooing over scarred skin in the Flash Challenge, a canvas asks for a Day of the Dead portrait of Tatu Baby, and artist Chuey Quintanar is a guest judge.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The artists transform models into animals in the Flash Challenge, and veteran tattoo artist Troy Denning judges the artists' Asian-style tattoos in the elimination challenge.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: Dave acts as a human canvas in the Flash Challenge, the artists struggle through landmark-themed tattoos, and color realism expert Nikko Hurtado is a guest judge.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The artists must tattoo one another in the Flash Challenge, surprise canvases sit for a pinup Elimination Tattoo, and NFL star NaVorro Bowman is a guest judge.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The artists etch designs into human skulls, canvases sit for super-villain-themed tattoos, and DC Comics artist Greg Capullo is a guest judge.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The artists get squeamish when tattooing eyelids, a canvas requests a portrait of one of the judges during the Elimination Tattoo, and artist Corey Miller is a guest judge.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The artists honor military veterans by engraving dog tags on the deck of an aircraft carrier, canvases get complex tattoos on their heads, and Twig Sparks is a guest judge.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: Past guest judges give the artists designs, one canvas sits for a simultaneous tattoo, and the artists are given the freedom to create Elimination Tattoos.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: America's vote brings two eliminated artists back for a live tattoo face-off, and after a final 35-hour tattoo, the judges award one artist with the title of Ink Master.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: A new batch of artists face off in a convention-style challenge to earn their spot in the competition, and the judges assign canvases to the artists in the elimination tattoo.

programme.title: Ink Master

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marissa, 22, says her family treated her like an outcast in childhood & she later began working as an escort to make ends meet. Marissa faces family for the first time in 3 years on Dr. Phil's stage. Did they indeed reject her & is there hope for repair?
programme.sub-title: I Am The Outcast Of My Family And They Threw Me Away Like Trash!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristen says two years ago she was manipulated into placing her newborn for adoption with her ex-stepfather Adam and his new wife, Stacy, who Kristen says promised she could remain in the child's life. Adam & Stacy insist they did everything by the book.
programme.sub-title: Adoption Nightmare: I Want My Baby Back

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ashley and Megan claim they were molested for years by their step-grandfather and their grandmother, Peggy, knew it was happening but did not stop it. The sisters face Peggy for the first time in seven years. Why does Peggy say they are lying? Part 1
programme.sub-title: Molested & Abused For Over 10 Years, Why Won't My Grandma Believe Me Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christi says she was an Emmy-winning TV news reporter at the top of her career, but now her struggle with alcohol has left her jobless, homeless and estranged from her two adult daughters. Christi faces her girls for the first time in more than two years.
programme.sub-title: From Top TV Newcaster To Drunken Mom

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sarah, 46, has sent over $1 million to her boyfriend, “Chris,” whom she has only met online. She says she dreams about marriage, once he’s able to return to the U.S. from Africa. Dr. Phil’s Facebook followers joined the effort to track down the man!
programme.sub-title: I Believe My Cousin Is Squandering Her Inheritance On A Love Scam

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brad says he is in a bitter custody battle with ex Kimberly, who's kept him from seeing their three kids. Kimberly says Brad is unstable & irresponsible and until he cleans up his act, he can't see their kids. Can these exes learn to peacefully co-parent?
programme.sub-title: My Ex Is Evil: I Want To See My Kids

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues conversation with Shemida and her sister, Dana, who says Shemida’s 70-plus diagnoses are tearing the family apart. Dr. Phil unites this family in an effort to find answers. Is Shemida really sick, or is she addicted to attention? Part 2
programme.sub-title: Hypochondriac, High Drama, Or Really Sick: Saving Shemida Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Amanda, 25, says she was molested over 795 times by her father, Earl Nix, a secret when revealed to family was rejected despite Nix being convicted of first-degree criminal sexual conduct. The family comes face-to-face in an emotional attempt for truth.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gina asked Dr. Phil for help with her daughter Alexis, saying she was kidnapped by her survivalist boyfriend David. As the story unfolds, another layer surfaces, allegations of molestation by a family member. Find out who, and will a polygraph tell all?
programme.sub-title: My Ex-Wife Claims I Molested Our Daughter Who Ran Off With Her Boyfriend Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Susie says she's at the end of her rope raising her 4-yr-old granddaughter & says daughter Adriana, 20, neglects her duties to spend time boyfriend Matt. Adriana strongly denies. Matt says he's judged for past drug use. Don't miss this emotional Dr. Phil.
programme.sub-title: I'm Raising My Granddaughter Because I Think My Daughter Is Violent, Abusive & Neglectful

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jana & Allen say neighbors Maritha & Melanie moved into the neighborhood: police reports, DFS, threats & their 4 dogs bark all hours of the night! Maritha & Melanie point to Jana & Allen, with Melanie being charged with misconduct for mooning a neighbor!
programme.sub-title: Neighbor Feud Erupts With Constant Calls To The Police, False Allegations, Trumped Up Charges, And Threats Of Violence

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Daniel says he and Lynsey are in a custody battle filled with lies and accusations and daughter Sophie, 4, is caught in the middle. Lynsey says after a visit with Daniel their daughter came home saying he hurt her. Dr. Phil sifts through the chaos. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Accusations Of Compulsive Lies, False Charges, & Coaching: A Dad's Fears About His Daughter's Safety At Mom's House Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sandra and ex-husband Joey admit they’re in a bitter custody battle. Sandra and Joey’s mudslinging has frightening accusations, but are they telling the truth? See what happens when these parents are offered polygraph and drug tests. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Bitter Custody Battle: Claims Of Poison In Ice Cream, A Child Wrapped In A Garbage Bag And Inappropriate Touching: What Will The Polygraph Reveal Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tina says her sons lived in a “house of horrors” with their biological father, Jeff, and his wife, Sandra, with reports to Child Protective Services that “fell on deaf ears.” Son Ian and Christa, also from the home, tell of horrific abuse they endured.
programme.sub-title: Adopted Twin, Beaten, Strangled, Starved And Locked In A Room: The Exclusive Interview

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gina says her daughter, Alexis, 18, was "kidnapped" and "held hostage" by her survivalist boyfriend, David, 19, which Alexis and David deny. Mom Gina fears for Alexis's safety. David agrees he’s a survivalist who owns guns, but he's not dangerous. Part 1
programme.sub-title: I'm Afraid My Daughter Was Kidnapped By Her Survivalist Boyfriend Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues dialogue with Amanda who says she was sexually abused by her father, Earl Nix. Hear what Earl said to Amanda during a police-recorded phone call, which the jury heard. Amanda agrees to take a polygraph. Will the results convince? Part 2
programme.sub-title: Amanda's Secret: Lie Detector Results Revealed Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brittany wrote to Dr. Phil devastated to discover that her boyfriend, the man she loves & with whom she is having a baby, leads a double life. But Dr. Phil discovered that Brittany was leaving out important details. What his team uncovered is shocking!
programme.sub-title: Multiple Restraining Orders And Fake Births: What's Next? Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Angie & Hannah who say step-father & step-grandfather Ralph routinely sexually abused them. For the first time in 15 years, Angie & Hannah are face-to-face with Ralph, who denies all claims. Is Ralph cleared by a polygraph test?
programme.sub-title: Did Step-Dad Molest His Step-Daughter And Granddaughter? The Polygraph Results Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tom and Karen say Madison, 15, is out of control. Tom has served seven tours of duty in the Middle East commanding troops but says he's faced his scariest and most dangerous enemy in his own home. Fearing for their lives, they need Dr. Phil’s help. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Police Called 100 Times On Our Car Stealing, Drug Taking, Dad Beating, Beautiful 15-Year-Old Daughter, Who Is Now Corrupting Her Younger Sister Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In one of the most bizarre love stories to come across Dr. Phil’s stage, now Dr. Phil uncovers a massive secret that changes everything with Ryan and Suzanne. Here is the conclusion to a fascinating tale of lies, deception and emotional extortion! Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Questionable Will & A Suspect Twin: Is This The Craziest Catfish Story Of Them All Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Calah Waskow, 15, made national news when allegedly abducted by her friend's 37-year-old dad. Issuing an Amber Alert, Calah was found five days later. What happened to her? Did she have a secret relationship with the older man? Calah tells her story.
programme.sub-title: 15-Year-Old Runs Away With Her Friend's Dad: The Amber Alert, The Search And The Rescue

programme.desc: "Love Island" continues as our cast of young singles settle into villa life and their daily routine of dating, flirting, dumping and more. The Islanders are already discovering that in paradise, you'd better be ready to expect the unexpected.

programme.desc: Questions are answered when Snooki, The Situation, JWOWW, DJ Pauly D, Angelina, Ronnie, Sammi and Vinny return for more fights and insights into what happened down at the Jersey Shore.

programme.title: Jersey Shore

programme.desc: When Mike invites girls back to the house, the situation gets out of control, and Snooki gets into her second fight of the summer. Meanwhile, Ronnie gets into a brawl of his own, leaving Sammi questioning their relationship.
